learning_objective: 🎯 Let's pack our imaginary bags! This beautiful poem teaches us about 'wanderlust'—the deep, exciting desire to travel and see the world, no matter where the train is going!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Even if the railway track is miles away, the poet can hear the train's whistle during the day and night. The sound of a train is like a magical call inviting us to leave our routine and explore the world.

Sometimes, we don't even need to buy a ticket to travel. Our imagination is the fastest train! The poem shows how we can daydream about traveling to unknown places just by looking at a map or hearing a vehicle.

The poet loves her friends and is very happy, but the urge to travel is so strong that she says she would take any train going anywhere! It shows how a curious mind always wants to see what lies beyond the horizon.

fun_activity.title: 🎟️ Design Your Dream Ticket!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a colorful piece of paper and design a VIP Train Ticket. Write your name, your ultimate dream destination (like Paris, the Moon, or a magical forest), and the boarding time!

quick_recap: ⭐ The poem captures the irresistible urge to travel and explore new places.
⭐ The distant sound of a train whistle acts as a reminder of the vast, unseen world.
⭐ Even when life is happy and comfortable, the human heart craves adventure.
⭐ Imagination allows us to travel anywhere in our minds at any time.
